literal: Goodness of mind [gives] prosperity to enduring living beings; goodness of association will give all fame.
translation: Goodness of mind brings prosperity to living beings, but goodness of association brings them all glory.
modern: மனதின் நன்மையானது நிலைபெற்ற உயிர்களுக்கு ஆக்கத்தைத் தரும்; நல்லினத்தின் சேர்க்கையானது எல்லாப் புகழையும் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the internal virtue of a pure mind with the external virtue of good companionship. Goodness of mind (மனநலம்) is essential for an individual's personal growth and brings prosperity (ஆக்கம்) to their life. However, goodness of association (இனநலம்) goes even further by bringing complete glory and recognition (எல்லாப் புகழும்) in the wider world. While a pure mind elevates one's character, the company one keeps determines how one is perceived and praised by society.
